title: Basic Internet Subscription Setup
description: Checks port availability at the user's residential address. Presents compatible internet speed packages for user selection. Allocates a port and creates the subscription order. Notifies the user and completes port configuration and physical connection
skill:
**Internet Subscription — Availability-Gated, Silent Setup**

Use this Blueprint when a new subscription requires inventory validation before proceeding and no user notification is needed after port allocation.

Flow: Retrieve BBK → Check inventory → [No inventory: end] → List speed products → User selects package → Allocate port → Configure port → Connect port to residence.

Exits silently after port connection. Exits early if inventory is unavailable.

agent.name: subscription_agent
agent.description: A agent optimized for subscription tasks, workflow assistance, and context-aware support within the system.

knowledge.text: Our office is located at 225 Wood St, London

context.userRequest: I want to buy new internet subscription

properties.label: Get BBK No by Address
properties.description: Resolves the BBK number for a given residential address. Identifies the corresponding network access point

properties.label: Get Inventory
properties.description: Queries available port inventory at the resolved BBK location. Returns availability status to gate the next workflow step

properties.label: Check if product is available
properties.description: Evaluates inventory availability status. Routes to product selection if available, terminates early if not

properties.label: Complete
properties.description: Ends the workflow when no port inventory is available at the user's address

properties.label: Get Product by Speed
properties.description: Fetches the internet product catalog filtered by compatible speed tiers. Prepares available options to present to the user

properties.label: User selected product
properties.description: Presents available product options to the user. Pauses the workflow until the user makes a selection

properties.label: Assign Port
properties.description: Reserves a network port for the user's selected product. Ties the port reservation to the user's address

properties.label: Notify Port Allocation
properties.description: Sends a confirmation notification to the user. Confirms that port allocation has been completed successfully

properties.label: Configure Port
properties.description: Applies network configuration parameters to the allocated port. Makes the port service-ready for physical connection

properties.label: Connect Port
properties.description: Establishes the physical network connection to the user's premises. Activates the service at the residential address

properties.label: Complete
properties.description: Marks the entire subscription setup workflow as successfully completed
